title: Compact derived source core
statement:
theorem compact_derived_source_core
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    {S : Type w} [rS : Ring S]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{max w vH} (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S)] :
    ∃ (B : Type (max uA vA ((max w vH) + 1))) (cB : Category.{max w vH} B),
      letI := cB
      ∃ (zB : HasZeroObject B) (sB : HasShift B ℤ) (pB : Preadditive B),
      letI := zB
      letI := sB
      letI := pB
      ∃ aB : ∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor B n).Additive,
      letI := aB
      ∃ tB : Pretriangulated B,
      letI := tB
      ∃ (iB : IsTriangulated B) (sumsB : HasCoproducts.{max w vH} B),
      letI := iB
      letI := sumsB
      IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{max w vH} B ∧
      ∃ (e : B ≌ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S))
        (se : e.functor.CommShift ℤ),
      letI := se
      e.functor.IsTriangulated

source.place: injectives-lemma-gabriel-popescu; Tag 0F5X first paragraph; Tag 05NU for Baer criterion in the size extension

proof.text: Choose complex representatives of each derived module object using the localization functor. Form their termwise coproduct, use derivedModuleDirectSums for its colimit property, and precompose the cofan legs with the representative isomorphisms. This constructs HasCoproducts for the native derived category.

Use native derived module compact generation. Let B be ULift of the actual derived module category, so its object universe is the required maximum and its Hom universe is unchanged. The ULift equivalence transfers all triangulated structures, the additive shifts and shift comparison. Transfer coproducts via the equivalence, and compact generation via compactGenerationEquivalence. Use the inverse equivalence, with its induced shift comparison, for the final triangulated equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Native compact generation followed by proved coproduct and universe transport constructions
